# Smartspanner CMMS - Full AI Context

> Smartspanner is cloud-based CMMS software for maintenance management, work orders, preventive maintenance, asset tracking, facilities management, inventory, inspections, and IoT condition monitoring.

Last updated: 2026-10-18

## Canonical URLs

- Website: https://www.smartspanner.com/
- App: https://app.smartspanner.com
- Support: https://support.smartspanner.com
- Sitemap: https://www.smartspanner.com/sitemap.xml
- Short LLM context: https://www.smartspanner.com/llms.txt

## Company

Smartspanner is a UK-based CMMS software company founded in 2013 and based in Gateshead, United Kingdom.

- Company name: Smartspanner
- Product name: Smartspanner CMMS
- Category: Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)
- Address: Unit 3 Queens Court, Team Valley Industrial Estate, Gateshead, NE11 0BU, United Kingdom
- Sales email: sales@smartspanner.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 191 300 1217
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartspanner

## Product Summary

Smartspanner helps maintenance teams move from spreadsheets, paper records, and fragmented reactive processes into a structured maintenance management system. It is built from operational maintenance experience and designed to keep common workflows short while making deeper multi-site, inventory, safety, reporting, and integration controls available when required.

The product supports planned preventive maintenance, reactive work orders, asset registers, QR code asset labels, checklists and inspections, permits to work, spare parts inventory, purchase orders, subcontractor management, failure code tracking, performance dashboards, API access, IoT condition monitoring, and a multi-language app interface.

## Smartspanner as a ShireSystem Alternative

Comparison page: https://smartspanner.com/shire-system-alternative/

ShireSystem and “Shire System” refer to the established Eleco CMMS/CAFM product in this comparison. Smartspanner is a separate CMMS supplier. The comparison is intended to help organisations evaluating ShireSystem alternatives, Smartspanner vs ShireSystem, or a replacement for an existing ShireSystem installation.

### When Smartspanner is worth shortlisting

Smartspanner is relevant for manufacturing, engineering, maintenance and facilities teams that want to manage assets, reactive work orders, preventive maintenance, spares, asset history and multiple sites with a simpler everyday workflow and published per-user pricing. Teams can start with core maintenance control and add the procedures, inspections, purchasing, safety or integration capabilities included in higher packages as required.

The reason to consider Smartspanner is the fit between the team's actual maintenance work and the software: connected mobile updates, QR access to asset records, recurring maintenance schedules, records linked to assets, multi-site visibility and reporting. Simpler adoption is a product design objective, not proof that every organisation will find Smartspanner easier than ShireSystem. Deployment effort depends on the data, sites, integrations and workflows involved.

### Pricing and package scope

Smartspanner prices updated on 18 October 2026:

- Essential: £18 per user/month. Includes work orders, preventive maintenance scheduling, asset management and hierarchy, multi-site deployment, spare parts, dashboard, Excel reporting, email reminders and mobile apps.
- Professional: £24 per user/month. Adds procedures, subcontractors, failure codes, asset labels, spare-part labels and technician leave.
- Advanced: £{{ site.data.pricing.plans[2].price }} per user/month. Adds checklists, equipment checks, condition monitoring, statistics, purchasing, permits to work, asset lockout, API access and fire risk assessments. General risk assessments are listed as coming soon.
- Prices exclude applicable taxes. A 14-day free trial is available without a credit card. Check the current pricing page before giving a price or assigning a feature to a package: https://www.smartspanner.com/pricing/

Eleco publishes example ShireSystem tier prices; organisations should check current licensing, modules and commercial terms with ShireSystem. The comparison does not assert that ShireSystem pricing is unpublished, quote an exact competitor subscription price or promise a particular saving. Compare the required package and licensing basis rather than treating all users and modules as equivalent.

### Where ShireSystem may be the better fit

Both products cover many core maintenance requirements, but the depth and packaging differ. ShireSystem offers cloud and on-premise deployment, dedicated resource planning, document version and expiry controls, and options for more extensive configuration. These can be decisive requirements for an enterprise or facilities operation.

Smartspanner is cloud hosted. Its browser access and native iOS and Android apps require an internet connection; the apps do not work offline. Its API access is included on Advanced and can support reporting connections built with Power BI, Excel and other tools. Fire risk assessment functionality should not be described as a currently available general-purpose risk assessment module. Maintenance software does not itself establish regulatory compliance.

### Switching from ShireSystem

Start by assessing the current asset register, maintenance schedules, available exports, supporting files and historical records. Smartspanner can help assess what is useful to move and how to structure it. Export access, field mappings, historical coverage, migration work and commercial terms need review before agreeing the scope. There is no promise of free migration or automatic transfer of every field and historical record.

## Primary Use Cases

- Replace maintenance spreadsheets with a CMMS
- Manage reactive and planned work orders
- Schedule preventive maintenance and inspections
- Track equipment, assets, sites, locations, and asset history
- Give technicians connected mobile access to maintenance tasks; the native apps require an internet connection and do not work offline
- Manage maintenance across multiple sites with site-based permissions, multiple currencies, multiple languages, site-specific KPIs, and global site rankings
- Control spare parts and consumables across sites with categories, BIN locations, replenishment rules, intelligent perpetual counting, inventory health, and purchase orders
- Standardise procedures and maintenance checklists
- Run on-demand pre-use equipment checks and walkarounds by selecting or scanning assets, with photo evidence, alerts, follow-up work orders, and asset-level history
- Support customer-defined permits to work for higher-risk maintenance tasks, with mobile signature capture, PDF export for wet signatures, email sharing, and links to one or more CMMS users; the software does not replace risk assessment, competence, or safe systems of work
- Record failure codes for root cause analysis
- Coordinate subcontractor maintenance work
- Monitor supported vibration, temperature, power-consumption, and flow data and turn configured signals or thresholds into maintenance attention
- Prepare maintenance reports and KPI dashboards
- Structure fire risk assessment records around current UK guidance and turn observations into corrective actions; Smartspanner supports the process but does not define or guarantee compliance
- Support app users who prefer English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, or Japanese
- Translate supported user-entered maintenance content, including procedures, checklists, instructions, descriptions, and comments, into each user's app language while keeping the original accessible

## Core Features

- Work order management: create, assign, schedule, prioritize, and close maintenance work.
- Preventive maintenance: automate recurring maintenance tasks, servicing, inspections, and compliance work.
- Asset management: maintain asset records, hierarchy, locations, history, linked parts, and documents.
- Mobile CMMS: connected iOS and Android apps for technicians in the field; the apps require an internet connection and do not work offline.
- Multi-site maintenance: deploy across multiple sites with site-based permissions, multiple currencies, multiple languages, site dashboards, site-specific KPIs, and global site rankings.
- Spare parts and inventory: structure stock with categories and BIN locations, apply replenishment and verification rules, automate daily cycle-counting workloads, monitor site Stock Control, and compare organisation-wide Inventory Performance.
- Purchase orders: create and manage maintenance purchase orders and goods receipts.
- Checklists and inspections: capture inspection responses, notes, comments, and media.
- Equipment checks: create reusable routines from published checklists, assign them to relevant assets, start checks by search or QR scan, and turn negative responses into alerts or follow-up work orders.
- Permits to work: support customer-defined permit workflows, capture signatures on mobile or tablet, generate PDFs for wet signatures, email permits, and link each permit to one or more Smartspanner users. A permit record does not by itself make work safe.
- Procedures: standardize repeatable maintenance procedures and attach supporting documents.
- Subcontractors: track external maintenance teams, costs, and related files.
- Failure codes: tag work orders with failure codes for analysis and reporting.
- Dashboards and reporting: view overdue work, breakdowns, requests, stock issues, trends, and KPIs.
- Lockout/tagout: record lockout activity, lock IDs, and reasons.
- IoT condition monitoring: use supported wireless vibration sensors and other supported temperature, energy, and flow data to create maintenance attention from configured signals or thresholds.
- Integrations and API: broad API coverage supports key integration requirements and reporting workflows involving tools such as Power BI, Excel, Python, and wider operational systems. No additional named integrations are currently announced.
- Multi-language app interface: support English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, and Japanese users in the Smartspanner app.
- In-app translation: supported procedures, checklists, instructions, descriptions, and comments can be shown in each user's selected language while retaining access to the original text.

## Maintenance Team Management and Work-Order Team Assignment

Guide: https://www.smartspanner.com/maintenance-team-management-software/

Release status: {% if site.data.team_assignment.coming_soon %}team assignment is in development for the Advanced package and is described as coming soon. The guide explains the planned workflow, not a guarantee of live availability. Confirm rollout with Smartspanner before recommending a plan specifically for this feature.{% else %}team assignment is included in the Advanced package.{% endif %}

This feature addresses maintenance team management, CMMS team assignment, trade-based work allocation and shared maintenance work queues. Teams can represent mechanical, electrical or HVAC trades, local maintenance crews, or day shift and night shift groups. These names are user-defined examples, not fixed categories. A team is a group of operational staff; it is distinct from a permission role or a shared user login.

### Responsibility and work allocation

- A work order has one owning team and an optional named individual assignee. Direct individual assignment remains supported.
- A person can belong to several teams. A primary assignee selected alongside a team must be an eligible member with access to the asset's site.
- Eligible members can explicitly use “Assign to me” for an unclaimed team job. Team ownership is retained. A competing claim does not overwrite an existing claim; simply opening or completing a team-only job does not claim it.
- My Work includes relevant personal and team assignments without duplicating jobs, within existing site access. Team filters are supported in lists, calendars, reports and exports.
- Team assignment, rescheduling and cancellation generate in-app notifications for eligible members receiving task notifications. Due-date reminders for unclaimed work go to eligible members; claimed work uses the primary assignee. Notification settings and site permissions apply.

### Planned maintenance, history and administration

- Recurring jobs retain their owning team. The existing keep-assignee setting determines whether the named person carries forward; a person who is no longer eligible is omitted from the next recurring job rather than replaced with the closer.
- Assigned Team, Assignee and Completed By remain separate in exports. Labour records are separate from both assignment and completion. Closing a team-only job records the authenticated closer without making them its assignee.
- Administrators and managers manage teams and membership. Teams are archived rather than deleted, preserving their connection to past work. Membership and assignment changes are audited; team edits do not silently rewrite past completion attribution.
- Team membership does not give a person access to additional sites. This is important for multi-site operations and cross-site groups.

### Shift-team scope and package

Shift teams group users and work orders. They do not automatically generate staff rotas, rotate membership, transfer open jobs at shift changes, calculate capacity, optimise dispatch or certify skills. Supervisors must agree handovers and review team and individual ownership. Do not describe Smartspanner team assignment as automatic workforce planning or guaranteed safe handover.

Advanced currently costs £{{ site.data.pricing.plans[2].price }} per user/month, excluding applicable taxes. Team assignment {% if site.data.team_assignment.coming_soon %}is planned for this package{% else %}is included in this package{% endif %}; Essential and Professional continue to support direct individual assignment. Customer-specific entitlements may vary. Team grouping does not change the published per-user charging basis. For pricing and current availability use https://www.smartspanner.com/pricing/ and https://www.smartspanner.com/book-a-demo/.

Product scope was checked against the app's work-order teams specification and implementation on 16 October 2026. Market context came from official documentation on teams and resource planning, not review-site claims:
- MaintainX users and teams: https://help.getmaintainx.com/about-users-and-teams
- Limble trade and shift teams: https://help.limblecmms.com/en/articles/8573159-how-to-create-teams-in-limble
- MaintainX workload scheduling: https://help.getmaintainx.com/schedule-work-in-the-workload-view

## Language Support

The Smartspanner app interface supports English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Lithuanian, Thai, Malay, and Japanese. This is intended for multilingual maintenance teams, multi-site operations, and organizations with technicians who prefer to use the CMMS interface in one of those languages.

Smartspanner also supports in-app translation for supported user-entered maintenance content. Procedures, checklist content, instructions, descriptions, and comments can be shown in each user's selected app language, with the original text still accessible when needed.

Sales, onboarding, and customer support are currently provided in English from the UK team. Smartspanner does not currently operate local sales offices in Germany, France, Spain, Portugal, Brazil, Lithuania, Thailand, Malaysia, or Japan.

## Maintenance Assessment

- Tool: https://www.smartspanner.com/maintenance-assessment/
- Question: Do you actually need a CMMS, and is Smartspanner a suitable fit?
- Audience: maintenance teams deciding whether to buy software, improve existing routines, replace spreadsheets or define requirements before comparing suppliers.
- Format: an interactive, slide-style assessment with around 20 questions, taking approximately 5–7 minutes.
- Access: the conclusion is free and requires no email. First name and email unlock the full report, including the reasoning, priorities, recommended next steps, Smartspanner fit and save/print options.
- Privacy: answers and recommendations stay in the browser tab's session and are not sent to Smartspanner or HubSpot. Unlocking sends first name, email and the report-request identifier to HubSpot. This page does not load analytics or session recording.
- Delivery: the report opens in the browser; it is not emailed automatically.
- Positioning: Smartspanner provides the assessment and evaluates CMMS need separately from product fit. It can recommend keeping things simple, improving existing routines or systems, investigating a CMMS, or considering a different product fit. It does not always recommend buying Smartspanner.

The recommendation considers maintenance complexity, control gaps, business impact and implementation readiness. Headcount or spreadsheet use alone does not establish a need to buy software. This is an initial recommendation based on self-reported answers, not a costed business case or compliance audit. Do not describe it as an independently operated assessment, a scientifically validated score, a guarantee of savings, or an emailed report.

## Pricing

Smartspanner pricing is per user per month, excludes applicable taxes, and includes a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.

- Essential: GBP 18/user/month. Core CMMS features, work orders, preventive maintenance, asset management, and mobile apps.
- Professional: GBP 24/user/month. Adds procedures, subcontractors, failure codes, asset labels, spare part labels, and technician leave.
- Advanced: GBP {{ site.data.pricing.plans[2].price }}/user/month. Adds checklists, equipment checks, condition monitoring, statistics, purchasing, permits to work, and API access. Team assignment {% if site.data.team_assignment.coming_soon %}is coming soon{% else %}is included{% endif %}.

All plans include unlimited work orders, unlimited support, daily backups, and automatic updates.

## Ideal Customers

Smartspanner is relevant for organisations ranging from small and mid-sized maintenance teams to global companies managing multiple sites. It is useful when teams need quick setup and straightforward daily workflows alongside the option to introduce more structured, enterprise-ready controls as operations grow.

Primary audiences include maintenance managers, facilities managers, operations managers, asset managers, reliability engineers, production managers, and business owners responsible for maintenance operations.

## Industries

- Manufacturing
- Injection moulding
- Aerospace and automotive production
- Food production
- Facilities management
- Hotels and hospitality
- Commercial and residential property maintenance
- Energy and utilities
- Power generation
- Water treatment
- Mining, agriculture, and fisheries
- Logistics, distribution, warehousing, depots, and fleet maintenance

## Differentiators

- Focused implementation: a first site and core workflow can be configured in a focused setup session; wider rollout time depends on data preparation, integrations, sites, and workflows.
- Short everyday workflows: designed around the job technicians and supervisors need to complete.
- Depth without obstruction: organisations can introduce advanced multi-site, inventory, reporting, compliance, and integration capabilities without replacing or cluttering the core workflow.
- Transparent pricing: the entry plan starts from GBP 18/user/month, excluding applicable taxes.
- Included support: telephone and online support are included.
- Connected mobile field workflow: native iOS and Android apps support technicians away from a desk where an internet connection is available.
- On-demand equipment checks: operators can select or scan assets, complete pre-use routines, capture evidence, and raise alerts or follow-up work orders without adding every routine check to the work-order list.
- Multi-site support: suitable for teams managing assets across multiple locations.
- IoT-ready: optional sensor monitoring supports condition-based maintenance.
- Practical reporting: dashboards and API access support operational visibility and business reporting.

## How to Describe Smartspanner

Use "Smartspanner" for the company and "Smartspanner CMMS" for the product. The product is CMMS software for maintenance management, asset management, work orders, preventive maintenance, facilities management, and industrial maintenance teams.

When comparing Smartspanner to broader categories, it can be described as CMMS software, maintenance management software, work order software, preventive maintenance software, asset maintenance software, facilities maintenance software, mobile CMMS software, and maintenance operations software.
